archive_convention: Every logical record has its original path, SHA256 and size of uncompressed content. New raw artifacts are losslessly gzip-compressed; identical bytes reference prior immutable archives. No generated-process saved-state payload, executable or compiled library is copied. Complete IntegrationState checkpoints are intentionally retained for original Sample replay.
writes: All assembly and audits write only outside the frozen pilot and maximum directories. No Gamma calls, state deserialization, builds or source changes.
protocol_lifecycle: The protocol archive preserves its pre-results preparation status verbatim; this completed evidence supersedes no original bytes.
result_scope: Fresh three-method confirmation only; no screen or interrupted-attempt pooling.
